counterfactual_missing_items: He had no pain or fever
two prior similar episodes over eight years
A clinical diagnosis of a nonspecific chronic abscess with buccal-space involvement was made
decisive_items: a well-defined soft-tissue mass with cystic areas in the right buccal space
Intracystic loculations with dense cystic content were noted
response.rationale: R4's raw spans directly describe the imaging findings of a well-defined cystic mass with loculations, most consistent with an abscess. R1's spans describe the gross specimen but are less specific. R5's span about bone erosion is a single finding. R2 and R7 have weak or unrelated spans. R3 and R6 have no raw support.

rejected.why: Gross specimen description is less specific than imaging findings
Prior infection history is nonspecific and does not establish staphylococcal cause
Single bone erosion finding is insufficient and not central to diagnosis
Diabetes and absence of pain/fever are nonspecific and do not support cheilitis
